name: Ali Abid
tagline: Software & systems developer — embedded, ML, and full-stack projects.
bio: I build things across the stack: from C/C++ engines and embedded hardware to Python ML and React apps. Below are some of my public projects, pulled live from GitHub.

descriptions.Bionic-Arm: Python control code for a bionic/prosthetic arm.
descriptions.NeuralNetwork: A feedforward neural network library written in C++ with a Python (ctypes) interface.
descriptions.physics_sim: A 2D/3D physics simulation written in C.
descriptions.chess_project: A chess engine in C that parses move sequences and validates them against the rules of chess (APSC 143 final project).
descriptions.Athabasca: A Java Swing desktop app for managing clients, assignments, and employees, backed by Firebase Realtime Database.
descriptions.Budget: A React budget-management app with interactive tables and Recharts-powered charts.
descriptions.Calc: A C++ calculator engine that tokenizes and evaluates expressions and solves equations using the Shunting Yard algorithm.
descriptions.Hackathon: Culminating Time — a Tkinter student-life simulation game where daily choices affect stress, health, and exam readiness.
descriptions.HABS: Hospital Appointment Booking System built with Python and PySide6 — accounts, symptom-based booking, and a calendar view.
descriptions.Leet: C++ solutions to LeetCode problems, organized by number and difficulty.
descriptions.MREN178_Project_2: A C++/wxWidgets project implementing graph pathfinding (MREN 178).
descriptions.mren178: A C++ project for the MREN 178 course.
descriptions.fundraiser-app: A simple app to help keep track of total amounts pledged
